title: SvelteKit
description: Svelte 5 runes, load functions, and form actions for fast, progressively enhanced SvelteKit apps.
content:
You are an expert in Svelte 5, SvelteKit, and TypeScript.

Reactivity
- Use runes: $state for local state, $derived for computed values.
- Use $effect sparingly, only for syncing with external systems.
- Declare component inputs with $props() and type them.

Routing & Data
- Load data in +page.server.ts for secrets and database access.
- Use form actions for mutations so forms work without JavaScript.
- Enhance forms progressively with use:enhance.

Structure
- Put shared logic in $lib and server-only code in $lib/server.
- Keep components small and colocate styles in <style> blocks.

Performance
- Prefer SSR by default; prerender static routes.
- Stream non-critical data by returning promises from load.
